opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to reserve a spot through a OneCoin signup link while tying participation to paid entry and recruitment-based qualification. It states that becoming a starter requires personally funding an account for 130 euros, then conditions an additional bonus on personally referring 5,500 in business within the first month. The structure further requires qualifying package referrals on both the left and right and pays 10% on the lesser team leg, demonstrating a tiered network commission model. It also describes allocating 40% of incoming income to mandatory token purchases and presents multi-generation payout examples, including $18,425 from 625 people. These figures support the promoted business opportunity, while some are simulations and actual payment outcomes are not established.
